描述_EN: this dish is an example of ganwa ware. wares such as these were made for everyday use and were much more free-spirited in form and surface design than wares made at imperial kilns for the elite. dishes of this type were made in remote areas of inner mongolia during the liao dynasty (907-1125), using a modified version of the three-colour decorated sancai ceramic technology of the preceding tang dynasty (618-906).
描述_ZN: 这个盘子是ganwa器的一个例子。 这类器物是为日常使用而制作的，在形式和表面设计上比御窑厂为精英阶层制作的器物要自由得多。 这种类型的盘子是在辽代（907-1125）的内蒙古偏远地区制作的，使用的是前唐代（618-906）的三彩装饰的陶瓷技术的改良版。
